messages.author: Chidi Okafor
messages.text: Line 3 has no CMM probe this week. Line 1 is the customer audit preparation both windows Thursday — board-protected, not movable without Henrike.

messages.author: Tunde Oyelowo
messages.text: Tooling side is fine: lot 3105-G1 (4 sets) is calibrated and covers a three-station line; the F2 nests are for the old datum and do not count. Re-cert afterwards is on RQ-3315.

messages.author: Chidi Okafor
messages.text: If anyone floats a second-shift extension to squeeze it into Thursday, that is a separate request to me. Nothing approved yet.
